 THE TIMES OF INDIA | Nov 08, 2026, 18:16:57 IST SUMMARY India vs Pakistan, Under-19 Asia Cup Live Score: India and Pakistan are set to renew their rivalry in a marquee Group A encounter at the Under-19 One-day Asia Cup today, with both teams arriving in confident mood after registering comprehensive victories in their opening matches. 
 India opened their campaign with a commanding 10-wicket victory over Nepal, chasing down a target of 128 in just 19.1 overs. The standout performer was Aaryavir Sehwag, son of former India opener Virender Sehwag, who struck an unbeaten 70 off 52 deliveries, including seven fours and four sixes. Captain Lakshya Raichandani also contributed an unbeaten 53 off 63 balls as India completed the chase comfortably. 
 Pakistan were equally impressive against tournament hosts UAE, securing a nine-wicket win after chasing 225 in 37.3 overs. Opener Usman Khan led the charge with an unbeaten 139 off 120 balls, while Jahangir Bilal and Abdul Qadir have also emerged as important contributors. Captain Farhan Yousaf will be particularly motivated, having led Pakistan to a massive 191-run victory over India in the previous edition. 
 For India, the bowling attack will be under scrutiny against a stronger batting unit. Ishan Sood, who claimed 3/18 against Nepal, will spearhead the pace challenge alongside Mohit Ulva. Spinners Yashveer Goud and Arjun Rajput, who shared five wickets in the opening match, will also have important roles. 
 The encounter carries significant importance for Group A standings and semi-final qualification. The top two teams from each group will advance to the last four, with the semi-finals scheduled for November 12 and the final on November 14. Commentary
